Exhaustive ordered pair cosine histograms AA 24+120, BB 40+240+120, AB 120+120 give the exact quadratic normalized variance 4[p²x+2p(1-p)y+(1-p)²z]. Independent reconstruction of all 784 pairs yields x=.00039245425, y=−.00017441869, z=.00014936512 and p*=.363533772216718, near expected .363533772216727; source rational interval certificate verifies signs without floating dependence. Strict convexity and completing square give unique minimizer and exact global quadratic stability, within this two-orbit area-measure family only.
